resources.string: Computers in your inner circle will be able to control this device with mouse and keyboard (Safeer Input). Removing a device from the circle stops this at once.
Safeer Input is on: computers in your inner circle can control this device with mouse and keyboard.
Android lets only you turn on Safeer Input. The Safeer Input page will open: select the switch with the remote and press OK.
Android lets only you turn on Safeer Input. The Safeer Input page will open: tap the switch and confirm.

Android restricted Safeer Input (restricted settings). On the app page open the “⋮” menu → “Allow restricted settings”, then turn on Safeer Input. If there is no such menu, installing from a computer (adb) lifts the restriction.
